title: Mate transmission to engine and lift the assembly into the car

notices.text: Mate the transmission to the engine on the cradle, onto the dowels, without forcing — never pull it together with the bellhousing bolts. Raise the assembly slowly, checking clearance to the body, coolant plumbing and A/C lines continuously. This is where the risk of damaging a brand-new engine is highest, so go slowly and use a second set of eyes.

steps.text: Mate transmission to engine and lift the assembly into the car.

fasteners.name: Engine mount to carrier, upper bolts
